NOTICE OF THE EXTRA-ORDINARY GENERAL MEETING OF THE SHAREHOLDERS OF ZAMEEN MEDALLION (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) LIMITED TO BE HELD ON____________________________ 
 
 Notice is hereby given that an extra - ordinary general meeting of the shareholders of the Company shall be held at the Company’s registered office located at 3 rd Floor, Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore , to transact the following business: 
 
 To discuss the alteration of provisions of the Memorandum of Association of the Company so as to change its principal line of business. 
 
 To discuss any other business relating to the Company with the permission of the chairman. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 By order of the Board of Directors
